entities.summary: Derrick LeRon Williams is an American professional basketball player for Suwon KT Sonicboom of the Korean Basketball League (KBL). He played college basketball for the Arizona Wildcats from 2009 to 2011. Williams was selected with the second overall pick by the Minnesota Timberwolves in the 2011 NBA draft.
